text: {"name":"process_bt_packet_status","confidence":"medium","docstring":"When BT packet parsing is enabled, parses the packet described by the nested receive context and stores the result in its status field; otherwise, it may disable an MMIO IRQ.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v2":"packet_context","v3":"parse_status"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":20,"meaning":"Packet header containing the packet type and length fields."},{"offset":36,"meaning":"Stored parser status, with the result repeated in adjacent bytes."},{"offset":48,"meaning":"Pointer to the packet context."},{"offset":72,"meaning":"Pointer to the receive buffer; parsing starts four bytes into it."},{"offset":76,"meaning":"Pointer to a structure containing the packet context pointer."}]}
